{{Quote|Citizens of the Inner and Outer Rim Territories, our exalted and wise Emperor has been forced to put down yet another insurrection in Imperial space. Vicious rebels, using weapons that have been traced to our sector, attacked an Imperial emplacement on Rampa II, wounding and slaying a number of Imperial troops.|[[Sarn Shild]]|<ref name="THG" />}}
'''Rampa 2''', also known as '''Rampa II''',<ref name="THG" /> was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="RD">''[[Rebel Dawn]]''</ref> located in the [[Rampa Minor system/Legends|Rampa Minor system]], within the [[Baxel sector/Legends|Baxel sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==History==
{{Quote|The Emperor's reprisal has been immediate, and the rebels have been routed and captured. Many civilian lives were lost when the rebel butchers turned their weapons on innocent civilians. This outrage cannot be allowed to continue!|[[Sarn Shild]]|<ref name="THG" />}}
In [[4 BBY/Legends|4 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] maintained an emplacement on Rampa 2 which became the target of a popular [[Rampa 2 uprising|uprising]].<ref name="THG" /> Although the rebels were brutally suppressed by the Empire&mdash;<ref name="RD" /> which claimed in its [[Propaganda/Legends|propaganda]] that the revolters had turned their weapons on innocent civilians&mdash;they inspired a similar [[Rampa 1 uprising|insurrection]] on [[Rampa 1]].<ref name="THG" />

{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Since Hutt Space is out here in the Rim, far from 'civilization'&mdash;that is, Coruscant&mdash;I'd bet Sarn Shild got stuck with all the older ships and weaponry, while all the newest, best stuff went to Rampa 1 and Rampa 2.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], to [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]|<ref name="THG" />}}
Rampa 2 was first mentioned in the [[1997]] novel ''[[The Hutt Gambit]]'', the second volume of ''[[Star Wars: The Han Solo Trilogy]]'' written by [[A. C. Crispin]].<ref name="THG" /> It was mentioned again in the [[1998]] novel ''[[Rebel Dawn]]'', the third volume of the trilogy.<ref name="RD" />

The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' created the [[Rampa Minor system/Legends|Rampa Minor system]] to differentiate Rampa 1 and Rampa 2 from [[Rampa III]], a planet introduced in [[Brian Daley]]'s ''[[Star Wars: The Han Solo Adventures]]'', establishing that they are not in the same [[Star system/Legends|system]].<ref name="TEA" />

Though ''The Essential Atlas'' places the Rampa Minor system rimward of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]],<ref name="TEA" /> comments made by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] during the events of ''The Hutt Gambit'' seem to imply that both Rampa 1 and Rampa 2 are not located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] but rather closer to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and civilization.<ref name="THG" />
